questions.question: In which year did World War II end?
questions.explanation: World War II ended in 1945 with the surrender of Germany in May and Japan in September.

questions.question: Who was the first President of the United States?
questions.explanation: George Washington was the first President of the United States, serving from 1789 to 1797.

questions.question: What was the name of the ship that brought the Pilgrims to America?
questions.explanation: The Mayflower was the ship that brought the Pilgrims to Plymouth, Massachusetts in 1620.

questions.question: In which year did Christopher Columbus first reach the Americas?
questions.explanation: Christopher Columbus first reached the Americas in 1492, landing in the Bahamas.

questions.question: What was the main cause of the American Civil War?
questions.explanation: While multiple factors contributed, slavery was the primary cause of the American Civil War.

questions.question: Who was the first Emperor of Rome?
questions.explanation: Augustus (Octavian) was the first Emperor of Rome, ruling from 27 BC to 14 AD.

questions.question: What was the name of the ancient Egyptian queen who ruled as pharaoh?
questions.explanation: All three were Egyptian queens, with Hatshepsut being the first female pharaoh.

questions.question: In which year did the Declaration of Independence get signed?
questions.explanation: The Declaration of Independence was signed on July 4, 1776.

questions.question: What was the name of the first successful English colony in America?
questions.explanation: Jamestown, established in 1607, was the first successful English colony in America.

questions.question: Who was the leader of the Soviet Union during World War II?
questions.explanation: Joseph Stalin was the leader of the Soviet Union during World War II.

questions.question: What was the name of the ancient Greek philosopher who taught Alexander the Great?
questions.explanation: Aristotle was the tutor of Alexander the Great and one of the most influential philosophers.

questions.question: In which year did the French Revolution begin?
questions.explanation: The French Revolution began in 1789 with the storming of the Bastille on July 14.

questions.question: What was the name of the first woman to win a Nobel Prize?
questions.explanation: Marie Curie was the first woman to win a Nobel Prize, winning in Physics in 1903.

questions.question: What was the name of the ancient Chinese philosopher who founded Confucianism?
questions.explanation: Confucius (Kong Fuzi) was the ancient Chinese philosopher who founded Confucianism.

questions.question: In which year did the Berlin Wall fall?
questions.explanation: The Berlin Wall fell on November 9, 1989, marking the beginning of the end of the Cold War.
